## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Backend tests pass (`cd backend && python -m pytest`)
- [ ] Frontend builds (`cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build`)
- [ ] I used a Conventional Commit-style title, such as `feat(profile): add student search`

## Merge

- [ ] Add the `automerge` label only after review is complete. The PR will merge as a **merge commit** once required checks pass.
